tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page background. Midnight is the default theme; Daylight is the light alternative.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, app bar, list rows: anything that sits on the page and carries an edge and hard shadow.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Insets inside a card: poster placeholders, chips, input wells.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The 2.5px outline on every card, button, chip and input. In Midnight it reads as a soft dark rim; in Daylight it is the crisp ink line from the logo.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers inside a card (between list rows, under the app bar). Never an outline for a component.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on surface-000/100/200.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Meta lines (year, runtime, director), labels, captions. Passes 4.5:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Bottle green, taken from the logo badge. Secondary buttons, poster tints, and the hard shadow under cards. Text on it: on-brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand (6.2:1).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: The logo's stripe green. Selected chip fill, active nav underline, hover tint on brand. Text on it: on-brand.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Moon amber, taken from the logo. The one warm spark: primary button, filled rating stars, the current-year chip. Use it once or twice per screen.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent (9.7:1).

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: The cat's fur from the logo. Highlights and illustration only; on Midnight it can carry large display text.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: The cat's cheeks. A tiny decorative accent (a 'new' dot, a heart on a favourite); never for text or for state.

tokens.name: cat-ink
tokens.usage: The cat's eyes and lids, from the logo. Mascot only.

tokens.name: star-off
tokens.usage: Empty rating star fill. Stars always carry an edge-coloured stroke so they read at 3:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px focus ring, offset 3px, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and the outline of an invalid input. Only for errors.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing heroes and empty-state headlines. One per screen.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Film title on the film page.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card headings and the wordmark in the app bar.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Film titles in rows and tiles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Rate what you watched and keep a quiet record of every night at the movies.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Year, runtime, director lines, in text-secondary.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-icon gaps (between rating stars).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, label-to-field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Stack gap inside a card's text block.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between list rows and between buttons.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between poster and details; between sections in a card.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tiny thumbnails, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Row thumbnails, inputs that are not pills.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, posters.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, search field.

shadow.note: Purrama's signature: hard, unblurred offset shadows (from Cardboard Brutal) on round, cushioned shapes. Never blurred drop shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card and list row: a bottle-green block offset down-right.

tokens.name: shadow-hero
tokens.usage: The one large card on a page (film header).

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, posters and small raised things: an edge-coloured block.

tokens.name: shadow-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed button: the shadow collapses as the button moves 3px down-right.

tokens.name: border-edge
tokens.usage: The outline on cards, buttons, chips, inputs, posters.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers inside a card.
